claim: Patchline ships a multi-cloud reproducible scale benchmark with identical results across three providers. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the multi-cloud claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make multi-cloud-scale-benchmark-gate`.
